description.zh:
视频文件起始偏移值。单位：毫秒。
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
></notice>

> 大于**0**，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置。
description.en:
The URL of the video-on-demand (VOD) file.
><notice>This parameter is active only when the video source is a file that is not in the Material Library.></notice>

> The VOD file must be in MP4, FLV, or TS format.

description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。

视频文件结束偏移值。单位：毫秒。
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
></notice>
        
- 大于**0**时：从相对于首帧的偏差时间为结束读取的位置。
- 小于**0**时：相对于最后一帧的偏差时间作为结束读取的位置。
description.en:
The start offset of the video file, in milliseconds.
><notice>This parameter is valid only when the video source is a file.></notice>

> A value greater than **0** specifies the offset from the first frame. The system starts to read the file from this offset.

description.zh: 该字段对视频进行固定延迟设置，可用于字幕同步。单位ms, 默认取值为0， 取值范围`[0-5000]`。
description.en: The PTS callback interval. The unit is milliseconds.

description.zh:
媒资库图片素材ID。
> 当视频源类型为图片时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en: This field sets a fixed delay for the video to synchronize captions. The unit is ms. The default value is 0. The value range is `[0-5000]`.

description.zh:
图片素材URL。
>当视频源类型为图片且图片文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。支持上传jpg、png格式图片，最大文件不可超过10M。
description.en:
The ID of the image asset.

> This parameter is active and required only when the video source type is Image.

description.zh:
阿里云直播流地址。

><notice> 
 
-  当视频源类型为直播流时，本参数必填。
 
-  视频源类型不是直播流时，请求时不要带这个参数。

></notice>
description.en:
The location identifier for the video source. This parameter is required.

The identifier references the video's position in the layout. Each location supports a maximum of one resource. The format is RV followed by a number from 01 to 99. For example, `RV01`.

description.zh:
用于标识视频源位置。本参数必填。 

定义布局内画面的引用编号，每个位置至多关联一个资源，格式需符合“RV01~RV12”，即RV+数字，数字范围`[01~99]`。
description.en: The name of the video source.

description.zh:
媒资库素材ID。
><notice>当视频源类型为素材时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
></notice>

如果您通过[DescribeCasterConfig接口](~~2848011~~)查询导播台配置信息，请查看DescribeCasterConfig接口调用返回的参数UrgentMaterialId值。

> UrgentMaterialId值即为媒资库素材ID值。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud streaming URL.

><notice>

- This parameter is required if the video source type is live stream.

- If the video source type is not live stream, do not include this parameter in the request.

></notice>

The number of times to repeat the video.
><notice>This parameter is valid only when the video source is a file.></notice>

- **0** (default): The video plays only once.

- **-1**: The video repeats indefinitely.

description.zh:
播放完后重复继续播放的次数。取值：
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
></notice>

- **0**（默认值）：不重复播放。
- **-1**：一直循环重复。
description.en:
The end offset value for the video file. Unit: ms.
><notice>This parameter is valid only when the video source is a file.></notice>

- A value greater than **0** sets the end point for reading at an offset from the first frame.

- A value less than **0** sets the end point for reading at an offset from the last frame.

The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, find the CasterId value in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to **Live Console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** to find the name of the production studio.

> The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

description.zh:
点播文件地址。
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频且视频文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。
></notice>

>点播文件仅限MP4、FLV、TS格式。
description.en:
The ID of the media asset.
><notice>This parameter is required and takes effect only when the video source is a media asset.></notice>

If you call the [DescribeCasterConfig](~~2848011~~) operation to query the configuration of the production studio, view the value of the UrgentMaterialId parameter in the response.

> The value of UrgentMaterialId is the ID of the media asset.

descriptions.zh:
请先创建导播台，再调用本接口添加导播台视频源。视频源数量受限于导播台输入路数。使用API创建导播台，请参见[创建导播台](~~2848009~~)。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you add a video source, you must create a production studio. The number of video sources that you can add is limited by the number of ingest endpoints in the production studio. For more information about creating a production studio by calling an API operation, see [Create a production studio](~~2848009~~).

## QPS limit

This operation is limited to 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which can impact your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-caster-video-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --resource-name test001 --location-id RV01 --live-stream-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea3734836620100000auth_key=1608953344-0-0-ac8c628078541d7055a170ec59a50000 --material-id f080575eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --vod-url http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/StreamName.flv --begin-offset 1000 --end-offset 10000 --repeat-num 0 --pts-callback-interval 2000 --fixed-delay-duration 0 --image-id a089175eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --image-url http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/image.jpg --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live AddCasterVideoResource --region cn-hangzhou --BeginOffset 1000 --MaterialId f080575eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --ResourceName test001 --LocationId RV01 --RepeatNum 0 --ImageUrl 'http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/image.jpg' --LiveStreamUrl 'rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea3734836620100000auth_key=1608953344-0-0-ac8c628078541d7055a170ec59a50000' --PtsCallbackInterval 2000 --FixedDelayDuration 0 --VodUrl 'http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/StreamName.flv' --EndOffset 10000 --ImageId a089175eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CasterId 'LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000'
